test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: F is the husband of G. G is the mother of H. H is the wife of I. I is the father of J. How is F related to J?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

1) F is the husband of G.

2) G is the mother of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a16452be85e617013ea120fe74057a825d10d3d7d5cdef150fcd4cd1bfd2b1d.png] 

3) H is the wife of I.

4) I is the father of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/121457d59c0525dd4f633874cad9805d3061500e8e3f5766827cb481a164919d.png] 

Thus, F is J's mother's father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
